title: Console list view: the personal "Group" picker offers formula fields, and picking one turns the whole list into a "数据加载失败" error page (the server refuses a formula group key since #29304)
body:
eval#1 · os-bob · session_012dn2AcTB69pEwZ9ugr1g1w

Filing gate: ① user-visible product defect, reproduced in the Console on the `os-dev-test` environment. ⛔ Not a claim; triage decides lane and grade.

## What happened

On a published list view of `c982_leave_request` (object has a formula field `display_title`, its `nameField`), the user opened the view's personal settings panel (打开记录 / 分组 / 隐藏字段 / 密度 …), clicked 「添加分组字段」 and picked 「申请标题」 — the formula field. The picker offered it with no mark. The list immediately became an error page:

```
数据加载失败
aggregate('c982_leave_request'): groupBy.0 groups by 'display_title', but 'display_title' is a formula field — its value is
computed on read and never stored, so no driver materialises it … Denormalise the value onto 'c982_leave_request' (a stored
field, written when the source changes) and group by that. …
```

The grouping is kept as a personal preference in the URL (`?uf__group=…display_title…`), so the view stays broken until the user finds 「清除」 in the same panel. The refusal text is written for a metadata author (denormalise, drivers), not for the business user who only picked an option the UI offered.

## Expected

The server-side refusal is correct (#29304, #30773). The Console grouping picker should not offer a field it knows the server refuses as a group key — formula fields (any `type: 'formula'`, i.e. virtual) — or, at minimum, show it disabled with a reason, and a grouping that the server refuses should fall back to the ungrouped list with an inline notice instead of replacing the list with an error page.

## Steps

1. Object with a formula field (e.g. `display_title: { type: 'formula', expression: "…" }`); publish; open its list view in the Console.
2. Open the view settings panel → 分组 → 添加分组字段.
3. The formula field is listed; pick it.
4. The list renders 「数据加载失败」 with the `aggregate … groupBy.0 … formula field` refusal.

## Filing notes

- Business reason: any object whose title is a formula (the pattern the authoring tools recommend for a numbered/composed name) lets every end user break their own list in two clicks; to them it reads as "the app is broken".
- Reader who acts: the `ui/` list-view seat (the grouping field picker in the view settings panel, and the grid's handling of a refused aggregate).
- Dedupe: `repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack is:issue` for `group by formula field` (608), `groupBy formula field aggregate` (77), `formula field grouping list view` (67) — #29304 / #30773 / #30824 made the server, authoring and skills refuse a formula group key; none covers the Console picker still offering it.
